title: The Little Cloud Afraid of Thunder: Finding Inner Bravery!

lines.text: High in the blue sky lived Cloudee, a fluffy, gentle little cloud!
lines.caps: High in the blue *SKY | lived Cloudee, a fluffy, *GENTLE | little *CLOUD!

lines.text: Whenever storm clouds gathered, a loud BOOM of thunder made Cloudee shake!
lines.caps: Whenever storm clouds *GATHERED, | a loud *BOOM of thunder made Cloudee *SHAKE!

lines.text: He hid behind the mountain peaks, wishing he was brave like the mighty wind!
lines.caps: He hid behind the mountain *PEAKS, | wishing he was brave like the *MIGHTY | *WIND!

lines.text: Then a tiny raindrop whispered, Being brave doesn't mean having zero fear!
lines.caps: Then a tiny raindrop *WHISPERED, | Being brave doesn't mean having *ZERO | *FEAR!

lines.text: Bravery is feeling scared inside, but choosing to take a gentle deep breath anyway!
lines.caps: Bravery is feeling scared *INSIDE, | but choosing to take a gentle *DEEP | breath *ANYWAY!

lines.text: Cloudee took a big breath and floated forward to water the thirsty forest flowers!
lines.caps: Cloudee took a big *BREATH | and floated forward to water the *THIRSTY | forest *FLOWERS!

lines.text: When the sun shone through his raindrops, a sparkling seven-color rainbow appeared!
lines.caps: When the sun shone through his *RAINDROPS, | a sparkling seven-color *RAINBOW | *APPEARED!

lines.text: You are braver than you know whenever you take that first little step!
lines.caps: You are braver than you *KNOW | whenever you take that *FIRST | little *STEP!

lines.text: Be brave and subscribe to BabyBeats Rhymo for daily stories!
lines.caps: *BE brave and | *SUBSCRIBE to | *BABYBEATS Rhymo | for daily *STORIES!
